pt.headline: Ondas perfeitas e vento leve no Coxos
pt.advice: Coxos oferece ondas de 1.8 m com período de 12 s e vento leve de 2 kt, água a 17 °C. Use fato 3/2 mm. Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 1727/26 em vigor na zona. Chegue cedo para evitar a multidão.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 10h para pegar as melhores seções.

en.headline: Perfect waves and light wind at Coxos
en.advice: Coxos has 1.8 m waves with a 12 s period and a light 2‑kt wind, water at 17 °C. Wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit. Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 1727/26 is in effect. Arrive early to beat the crowd.
en.crowdTip: Get there before 10 am to catch the best sections.
en.moonTideLine: Waxing gibbous · Neap tides · low tide 20:00

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas (1.8 m) e vento moderado (4 kt). Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 12/24, mas seguro para surf.
spots.enReason: Good waves (1.8 m) and moderate wind (4 kt). Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 12/24, still safe to surf.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Ondas decentes (1.7 m) mas vento mais forte (6 kt). Avisos de interação e avistamento de animais marinhos.
spots.enReason: Decent waves (1.7 m) but stronger wind (6 kt). Marine animal interaction and sighting warnings.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas maiores (1.9 m) e vento leve (2 kt). Sem avisos costeiros, ótimo para surf.
spots.enReason: Larger waves (1.9 m) and light wind (2 kt). No coastal warnings, great for surfing.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas (1.9 m) mas vento forte (7 kt). Aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos.
spots.enReason: Good waves (1.9 m) but strong wind (7 kt). Marine animal sighting warning.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de 1.8 m, vento leve (2 kt) e água agradável. Aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos, mas condições ideais.
spots.enReason: 1.8 m waves, light wind (2 kt) and pleasant water. Marine animal sighting warning, but ideal conditions.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Ondas pequenas (1.4 m) e aviso de plano de salvamento marítimo. Não vale a pena hoje.
spots.enReason: Small waves (1.4 m) and a maritime rescue plan warning. Not worth surfing today.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas curtas (1.4 m) e múltiplos avisos de segurança. Melhor procurar outro spot.
spots.enReason: Short waves (1.4 m) and multiple safety warnings. Better to surf elsewhere.
